verses.kjv: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.decoded: And Moses selected capable men from all of Israel and appointed them as leaders over the people: commanders of thousands, commanders of hundreds, commanders of fifties, and commanders of tens.

verses.kjv: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.decoded: And they judged the people at all times; they brought the difficult cases to Moses, but they themselves judged every minor issue.

verses.kjv: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.decoded: And Moses allowed his father-in-law to leave; and he returned to his own country.

verses.kjv: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.decoded: In the third month, when the Israelites had departed from the land of Egypt, on that very day, they arrived in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.kjv: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
verses.decoded: Because they had traveled from Rephidim, they arrived at the Sinai desert and set up camp in the wilderness; and there the people of Israel camped in front of the mountain.

verses.kjv: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
verses.decoded: And Moses ascended to God, and the Lord summoned him from the mountain, saying, 'This is what you are to say to the descendants of Jacob, and inform the people of Israel;'

verses.kjv: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.decoded: You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I carried you on eagles' wings, and brought you to myself.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
verses.decoded: So now, if you will truly listen to and obey what I say, and uphold my agreement, then you will be a special possession to me, more than all other nations, because the entire earth belongs to me.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And you will be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation. These are the words that you must speak to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
verses.decoded: Moses then went and summoned the elders of the people, and he presented to them all the instructions that the Lord had given him.

verses.kjv: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And all the people responded together, saying, 'We will do everything the LORD has commanded.' Then Moses reported the people's words back to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, "Look, I am coming to you in a dense cloud, so that the people may hear when I speak with you, and they will always believe in you."

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, 'Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow, and have them wash their clothes.'

verses.kjv: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.decoded: And be prepared by the third day, because on the third day the LORD will descend, visible to all the people on Mount Sinai.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.decoded: And you must establish boundaries for the people all around, telling them, Be careful that you do not go up onto the mountain, or even touch its edge. Anyone who touches the mountain will certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.decoded: No hand is to touch it; instead, the person who touches it must certainly be stoned or shot with an arrow. Whether it is an animal or a human, it will not be allowed to live. When the ram's horn sounds a long blast, then they may come up to the mountain.

verses.kjv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.decoded: Then Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and he consecrated the people; and they washed their clothes.

verses.kjv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
verses.decoded: And he told the people, 'Be prepared for the third day: do not have sexual relations with your wives.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
verses.decoded: And it happened on the third day, in the morning, that there were thunder and lightning, and a dense cloud on the mountain, and the sound of a very loud trumpet; so that all the people in the camp trembled.

verses.kjv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.decoded: And Moses led the people out of their encampment to meet with God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

verses.kjv: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.decoded: And Mount Sinai was entirely covered in smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire; and its smoke rose up like the smoke from a furnace, and the entire mountain shook violently.

verses.kjv: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
verses.decoded: And when the sound of the trumpet continued for a long time, growing steadily louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God responded to him with a voice.

verses.kjv: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.decoded: Then the Lord descended upon Mount Sinai, to the very summit of the mountain. And the Lord summoned Moses to come up to the summit of the mountain, and Moses ascended.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, Go down and warn the people, so that they do not break through to the Lord to look, and many of them die.

verses.kjv: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
verses.decoded: Also, the priests who approach the Lord must purify themselves, so that the Lord does not act against them.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the Lord, "The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai, because you commanded us, saying, 'Set boundaries around the mountain and make it holy.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to him, 'Go away, go down, and you, along with Aaron, shall come up. But do not let the priests and the people force their way through to come up to the Lord, so that he does not break out against them.'

verses.kjv: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.decoded: Therefore, Moses descended to the people and spoke to them.

verses.kjv: And God spake all these words, saying,
verses.decoded: Then God spoke all these words, saying:

verses.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.decoded: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the place of slavery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.decoded: You must not have any other gods besides me.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.decoded: You shall not make for yourself any carved idol, or any representation of anything that is in the sky above, or that is on the earth below, or that is in the water beneath the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.decoded: You shall not bow down to them or serve them, because I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, who punishes the wrongdoing of the parents on their children down to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me.

verses.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.decoded: And showing compassion to countless generations of those who love me and obey my commands.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.decoded: You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, because the Lord will not consider anyone innocent who misuses his name.

verses.kjv: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.decoded: Remember the Sabbath day, to set it apart as sacred.

verses.kjv: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
verses.decoded: For six days you shall work and perform all your tasks.

verses.kjv: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
verses.decoded: However, the seventh day is the Sabbath of the Lord your God. On that day, you must not do any work, neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor the foreigner residing within your towns.

verses.kjv: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.decoded: Because in six days the Lord created the sky and the land, the sea, and everything that exists within them, and then ceased work on the seventh day; for this reason, the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and declared it holy.

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.decoded: Respect your father and your mother, so that you may live a long time in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.decoded: You shall not murder.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.decoded: You shall not commit adultery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.decoded: You must not steal.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.decoded: You must not give false testimony against your fellow human being.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.
verses.decoded: You shall not desire your neighbor's house. You shall not desire your neighbor's wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that belongs to your neighbor.

verses.kjv: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.decoded: And all the people observed the thunder, and the lightning, and the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain emitting smoke. When the people witnessed these phenomena, they moved away and stood at a distance.

verses.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
verses.decoded: And they said to Moses, 'You speak with us, and we will listen; but do not let God speak with us, otherwise we will die.'

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the people, 'Do not be afraid, for God has come to test you, so that your reverence for Him is always before you, and you do not sin.'

verses.kjv: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
verses.decoded: And the people remained at a distance, while Moses approached the dense darkness where God was present.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, 'This is what you are to say to the Israelites: You yourselves have seen that I have spoken with you from heaven.'

verses.kjv: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
verses.decoded: You must not make gods of silver to be worshipped alongside me, nor should you make gods of gold for yourselves.

verses.kjv: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
verses.decoded: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and on it, you shall sacrifice your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where I cause my name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.

verses.kjv: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.decoded: And if you want to build me an altar made of stone, you must not construct it from cut or shaped stones, because if you use your tool on it, you have defiled it.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.decoded: You must not go up to my altar using steps, so that your lower body is not exposed on it.

verses.kjv: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, these are the laws that you are to present to them.

verses.kjv: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.decoded: If you purchase a Hebrew servant, he is to serve for six years. Then, in the seventh year, he shall be released without having to pay anything for his freedom.

verses.kjv: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.decoded: If he arrived alone, he will leave alone; if he was married, then his wife will leave with him.

verses.kjv: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.decoded: If his master has given him a wife, and she has borne him sons or daughters, then the wife and her children will belong to her master, and he alone will go free.

verses.kjv: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.decoded: But if the servant clearly states, 'I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free,'

verses.kjv: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.decoded: Then his master must bring him before the judges; he must also bring him to the door or to the doorpost; and his master must pierce his ear with an awl; and he will serve him permanently.

verses.kjv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.decoded: If a man sells his daughter to become a female servant, she will not be set free in the same way that male servants are.

verses.kjv: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.decoded: If she does not satisfy her master, who had designated her for himself as a wife, then he must allow her to be bought back. He will not have the right to sell her to a foreign people.

verses.kjv: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.decoded: And if he has promised her in marriage to his son, he must treat her as he would his own daughters.

verses.kjv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.decoded: If he marries another wife, he must not reduce her food, her clothing, or her conjugal rights.

verses.kjv: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.decoded: But if he does not provide these three things for her, then she shall go free without any payment.

verses.kjv: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.decoded: Whoever strikes a person, causing that person's death, must certainly be executed.

verses.kjv: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
verses.decoded: And if a person does not intentionally ambush someone, but it is an accident and God allows the victim to die by his hand, then I will designate a place where the killer can go for refuge.

verses.kjv: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
verses.decoded: However, if a man deliberately and arrogantly attacks his neighbor with the intent to kill him through deceit, you must remove him even from my altar, so that he may be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.decoded: And the person who strikes their father or their mother will certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: And anyone who kidnaps a person and sells them, or if the kidnapped person is found in their possession, that individual shall certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: The person who curses his father or his mother must certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
verses.decoded: If men are fighting and one strikes another with a stone or with his fist, and the injured person does not die but is confined to his bed:

verses.kjv: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
verses.decoded: If the injured person recovers and is able to walk outside with the aid of a staff, then the person who struck him will be absolved of further punishment; however, the assailant must compensate him for the time he lost from work and must also ensure that the injured person is completely cured.

verses.kjv: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
verses.decoded: And if a man strikes his male or female servant with a rod, and the servant dies as a result of his action, the man must certainly be punished.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
verses.decoded: However, if the injured person survives for a day or two, the one who caused the injury will not be punished, because the injured person is his property.

verses.kjv: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.decoded: If men are fighting and injure a pregnant woman, causing her to miscarry or give birth prematurely, but no further serious harm comes to the woman, the man responsible will certainly be punished according to what the woman's husband demands from him, and he must pay the amount decided by the judges.

verses.kjv: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
verses.decoded: And if any harm results, then you must give a life for a life.

verses.kjv: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.decoded: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, a foot for a foot.

verses.kjv: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.decoded: A burn for a burn, a wound for a wound, a bruise for a bruise.

verses.kjv: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
verses.decoded: If a man strikes the eye of his male servant or the eye of his female servant, and it is destroyed, he must set the servant free as compensation for the eye.

verses.kjv: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
verses.decoded: And if he knocks out the tooth of his male servant, or the tooth of his female servant, he must set the servant free as compensation for the tooth.

verses.kjv: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.decoded: If an ox fatally injures a man or a woman, causing their death, then the ox must certainly be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten; however, the owner of the ox will be acquitted.

verses.kjv: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: However, if an ox was previously known to gore with its horn, and its owner had been informed of this tendency, yet the owner failed to keep it restrained, and the ox then killed a man or a woman, then the ox must be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten. Furthermore, the owner of the ox must also be executed.

verses.kjv: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.decoded: If a monetary penalty is imposed on him, then he must pay to save his life whatever amount is required of him.

verses.kjv: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.decoded: If the ox has gored a son or a daughter, this same ruling shall be applied to the owner.

verses.kjv: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.decoded: If the ox gores a male slave or a female slave, the ox's owner must pay their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox must be killed by stoning.

verses.kjv: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.decoded: If someone opens a pit or digs a pit and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it;

verses.kjv: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.decoded: The owner of the pit must pay compensation, giving money to the owner of the animals; and the dead animal will belong to the pit's owner.

verses.kjv: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
verses.decoded: If one person's ox injures another person's ox, causing it to die, then they must sell the surviving ox and divide the money from it, and they must also divide the dead ox.

verses.kjv: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.decoded: Or if it is known that the ox has previously had a habit of goring, and its owner has not kept it confined, then the owner must certainly pay an ox for the ox that was killed, and the dead ox will belong to the owner of the goring ox.

verses.kjv: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.decoded: If a person steals an ox or a sheep, and then either slaughters it or sells it, that individual must repay five oxen for the stolen ox and four sheep for the stolen sheep.

verses.kjv: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
verses.decoded: If a thief is discovered in the act of breaking into a property, and is struck so severely that he dies, the person who struck him will not be held responsible for his death.

verses.kjv: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.decoded: If a thief is caught breaking in and is struck so that he dies, no one will be held accountable for his death.

verses.kjv: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.decoded: If the stolen animal is definitely found alive in the possession of the thief, whether it is an ox, a donkey, or a sheep, the thief must repay twice its value.

verses.kjv: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.decoded: If a person allows their livestock to graze in a field or vineyard, and lets their animal feed in another person's field, they must make restitution from the best produce of their own field and vineyard.

verses.kjv: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.decoded: If a fire starts and spreads to thorns, causing stacks of grain, standing grain in the field, or the entire field to be destroyed by it, the person who started the fire must certainly pay compensation.

verses.kjv: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.decoded: If a person entrusts money or possessions to their neighbor for safekeeping, and these items are stolen from that person's house; if the thief is caught, they must pay back double the value.

verses.kjv: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.
verses.decoded: If the thief is not found, then the owner of the house must be brought before the judges to determine whether he has taken his neighbor's property.

verses.kjv: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.decoded: In any case of wrongdoing, whether it involves an ox, a donkey, a sheep, clothing, or any kind of lost item which another person claims as their own, the dispute between both parties must be brought before the judges; and the person whom the judges declare guilty must pay double the value to their neighbor.

verses.kjv: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.decoded: If a person entrusts to their neighbor a donkey, or an ox, or a sheep, or any other animal, to guard; and it dies, or is injured, or is taken away, with no one having witnessed it.

verses.kjv: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
verses.decoded: Then a solemn oath before the Lord will be taken by both of them, affirming that the one entrusted with the goods did not take his neighbor's property; and the owner will accept this oath, and the one entrusted will not be required to provide compensation.

verses.kjv: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.decoded: And if it is stolen from him, he must make compensation to its owner.

verses.kjv: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.decoded: If it is torn into pieces, then the person must present the remains as evidence, and they will not be required to compensate for the animal that was torn.

verses.kjv: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.decoded: And if a person borrows anything from their neighbor, and it is injured or dies while its owner is not present with it, the borrower must certainly compensate for it.

verses.kjv: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.decoded: But if the owner of the animal is present with it, the borrower is not obligated to compensate for the loss; if the animal was rented, the rental fee already covers the risk or loss.

verses.kjv: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.decoded: And if a man persuades a young, unmarried woman who is not engaged to be married, and has sexual intercourse with her, he must certainly provide a marriage gift for her and she shall become his wife.

verses.kjv: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.decoded: If her father completely refuses to give her to him in marriage, the man must pay the customary bride-price for virgins.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
verses.decoded: You must not allow a sorceress to live.

verses.kjv: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: Anyone who has sexual intercourse with an animal must certainly be executed.

verses.kjv: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.decoded: Anyone who offers sacrifices to any god, except to the Lord alone, will be completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: You must not mistreat a foreigner or oppress them, because you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.decoded: You must not mistreat any widow or child without a father.

verses.kjv: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.decoded: If you mistreat them in any way, and they cry out to me, I will certainly hear their cry;

verses.kjv: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.decoded: My anger will become intense, and I will kill you with a sword; then your wives will become widows, and your children will be without a father.

verses.kjv: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
verses.decoded: If you lend money to any of my people who are poor among you, you must not act like a moneylender toward them, nor should you charge them interest.

verses.kjv: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
verses.decoded: If you take your neighbor's clothing as collateral, you must return it to him before the sun sets.

verses.kjv: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.decoded: Because that is his only covering, it is his clothing for his body. How else will he sleep? And it will happen that when he cries out to me, I will listen, because I am compassionate.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
verses.decoded: You must not insult gods, nor curse the ruler of your people.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
verses.decoded: You must not delay in offering the first of your ripe produce and your liquids. You must give the firstborn of your sons to me.

verses.kjv: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
verses.decoded: You shall do the same with your cattle and your sheep: for seven days it shall remain with its mother; on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.decoded: And you are to be a people consecrated to me. Therefore, you must not eat any meat that has been torn by wild animals in the field; instead, you must throw it to the dogs.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.decoded: You must not spread a false report; do not join with the wicked to be an unjust witness.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verses.decoded: You must not follow a large group of people to do wrong; nor should you testify in a legal case in a way that goes along with the majority to distort justice.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.decoded: You must not show favoritism to a poor person in their legal case.

verses.kjv: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.decoded: If you encounter your enemy's ox or his donkey wandering off, you must certainly return it to him.

verses.kjv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
verses.decoded: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you lying under its load, and you would hesitate to help, you must certainly help him with it.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.decoded: You must not pervert the justice due to your poor person in their legal case.

verses.kjv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.decoded: Stay away from any false accusation or deceitful situation; and do not put to death the innocent and the righteous, for I will not declare the wicked to be just.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.decoded: You must not accept a bribe, because a bribe blinds even those who are wise and distorts the statements of the righteous.

verses.kjv: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: Also, you must not mistreat a foreigner, because you understand the feelings of a foreigner, since you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.decoded: For six years, you shall plant your land and harvest its produce.

verses.kjv: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
verses.decoded: However, in the seventh year, you must allow the land to remain uncultivated and untouched, so that the impoverished among your people may consume what grows naturally; and whatever they leave behind, the wild animals of the field shall eat.

verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.decoded: For six days you shall do your work, but on the seventh day you shall rest. This is so your ox and your donkey can rest, and the son of your female servant, as well as the foreigner, may be refreshed.

verses.kjv: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
verses.decoded: And concerning all that I have commanded you, be careful: and do not mention the names of other gods, nor let their names be spoken by you.

verses.kjv: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.decoded: Three times in the year you shall observe a feast for me.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.decoded: You must observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread: you must eat unleavened bread for seven days, as I instructed you, at the designated time in the month of Abib, because during that month you departed from Egypt; and no one should come before me empty-handed.

verses.kjv: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
verses.decoded: You shall also observe the Festival of Harvest, celebrating the first produce of your work, from what you have planted in the field. And you shall observe the Festival of Ingathering, which occurs at the end of the year, when you have collected the results of your work from the field.

verses.kjv: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the LORD God.
verses.decoded: Three times a year, all your male individuals must present themselves before the Lord God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.decoded: You must not present the blood of my sacrifice with bread containing yeast; nor shall the fat of my sacrifice be left until the morning.

verses.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
verses.decoded: You must bring the very first and best produce from your land to the sanctuary of the Lord your God. You must not boil a young goat in the milk of its own mother.

verses.kjv: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.decoded: Look, I am sending a messenger ahead of you to protect you on the journey and to lead you to the place that I have prepared.

verses.kjv: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.decoded: Be cautious of him and obey his instructions; do not provoke him, because he will not forgive your wrongdoings, for my authority is in him.

verses.kjv: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.decoded: But if you truly obey his voice and do everything I command, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.

verses.kjv: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.decoded: For my messenger will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I will eliminate them.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.decoded: You must not worship their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices; instead, you must completely destroy them and thoroughly shatter their idols.

verses.kjv: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.decoded: And you shall serve the Lord your God, and he will bless your food and your water, and I will remove illness from among you.

verses.kjv: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.decoded: Nothing will suffer miscarriage or be barren in your land; I will ensure you live a full lifespan.

verses.kjv: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.decoded: I will send a sense of dread ahead of you, and I will cause the destruction of all the people to whom you go, and I will make all your enemies flee from you.

verses.kjv: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.decoded: And I will send hornets ahead of you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from your presence.

verses.kjv: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
verses.decoded: I will not expel them from your presence in a single year, so that the land does not become deserted and wild animals do not increase in number and become a problem for you.

verses.kjv: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.decoded: Gradually, I will expel them from your presence, until your population has increased and you take possession of the land.

verses.kjv: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.decoded: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea all the way to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates River. For I will hand over the people living in the land to you, and you will drive them out from before you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.decoded: You must not make any agreement with them, nor with their gods.

verses.kjv: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
verses.decoded: They must not live in your land, otherwise they will cause you to sin against me; for if you worship their gods, it will certainly become a trap for you.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
verses.decoded: And he said to Moses, Come up to the Lord, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

verses.kjv: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.decoded: Only Moses is permitted to approach the Lord; however, the others (Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and the seventy elders) are not to come close, nor are the rest of the people to ascend the mountain with him.

verses.kjv: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
verses.decoded: Then Moses came and informed the people of all the messages from the Lord and all the laws. And all the people responded unanimously, saying, 'We will do everything the Lord has said.'

verses.kjv: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moses wrote down all the words that the Lord had spoken. Then, getting up early in the morning, he built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars, corresponding to the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And he sent young men from the Israelites, who presented burnt offerings and sacrificed oxen as peace offerings to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.decoded: Moses took half of the blood and placed it in bowls, and he sprinkled the other half of the blood on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.decoded: Then he took the book containing the covenant and read it aloud to the people. And they responded, 'We will do everything the LORD has commanded, and we will obey.'

verses.kjv: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
verses.decoded: Moses then took the blood and sprinkled it on the people, saying, 'Look, this is the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you concerning all these terms.'

verses.kjv: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
verses.decoded: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel ascended.

verses.kjv: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
verses.decoded: And they saw the God of Israel; and under his feet there was what appeared to be a pavement made of sapphire stone, and what appeared to be the very essence of the sky in its pure clarity.

verses.kjv: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
verses.decoded: And he did not harm the leaders of the Israelites; they also saw God and ate and drank.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
verses.decoded: Then the Lord told Moses, 'Come up to me on the mountain and stay there. I will give you stone tablets inscribed with the law and the commandments that I have written, so that you may teach them.'

verses.kjv: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.decoded: Moses got up, along with his assistant Joshua, and Moses ascended the mountain of God.

verses.kjv: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.decoded: And he said to the elders, 'Stay here for us until we return to you. And look, Aaron and Hur are with you; if anyone has any issues to deal with, let him go to them.'

verses.kjv: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.decoded: And Moses ascended the mountain, and a cloud covered the mountain.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.decoded: And the magnificent presence of the Lord remained on Mount Sinai, and a cloud enveloped the mountain for six days; and on the seventh day, He summoned Moses from within the cloud.

verses.kjv: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And the visible manifestation of the Lord's glory appeared as a consuming fire on the summit of the mountain, as the Israelites observed.

verses.kjv: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.decoded: And Moses went into the middle of the cloud, and he ascended the mountain: and Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Israel to bring me an offering. From every man who gives it willingly from his heart, you are to take my offering.

verses.kjv: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.decoded: And this is the contribution you are to receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
verses.decoded: And blue material, and purple material, and scarlet material, and fine linen, and goat hair.

verses.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
verses.decoded: And red-dyed ram skins, and badger skins, and acacia wood,

verses.kjv: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.decoded: Olive oil for the lamp, spices for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense,

verses.kjv: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.decoded: Onyx gemstones, and other gemstones to be placed in the ephod and in the breastplate.

verses.kjv: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.decoded: And they are to make a sanctuary for me, so that I may dwell among them.

verses.kjv: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.decoded: You must construct it exactly as I show you, following the design of the sacred tent and the design of all its equipment.

verses.kjv: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.decoded: They are to make a chest from acacia wood. Its length is to be two and a half cubits, its width one and a half cubits, and its height one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.decoded: And you shall cover it with pure gold; you shall cover it both inside and outside, and you shall make a border of gold around its top.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.decoded: And you shall make four gold rings for it, and place them on its four corners; with two rings on one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.decoded: And you are to make poles from acacia wood, and cover them with gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, so that the ark may be carried with them.

verses.kjv: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.decoded: The carrying poles must remain in the rings of the ark; they are not to be removed from it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.decoded: And you shall place into the chest the decree that I will give to you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.decoded: And you shall make a cover for atonement from pure gold: its length shall be two and a half cubits, and its width one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.decoded: And you are to make two cherubim of gold; you are to make them from hammered metal, at the two ends of the atonement cover.

verses.kjv: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.decoded: You are to make one cherub at one end and the other cherub at the other end; you shall make the cherubim from the mercy seat itself, at its two ends.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.decoded: And the cherubim will extend their wings upward, covering the atonement cover with their wings, and their faces will be turned toward each other.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the atonement cover on top of the ark; and inside the ark you shall place the tablets of the covenant that I will give you.

verses.kjv: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And there I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the atonement cover, from between the two winged figures that are on the chest containing the covenant.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.decoded: You shall also make a table of acacia wood; its length shall be two cubits, its width one cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.decoded: And you are to cover it with pure gold, and make for it a molding of gold all around.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.decoded: You are to make a rim for it, approximately a hand's width wide, all around its edge, and you are to make a decorative gold molding for its rim all around.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.decoded: You are to make four gold rings for it and attach these rings to its four corners, specifically on its four legs.

verses.kjv: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.decoded: The rings are to be placed adjacent to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.decoded: And you shall make the carrying poles from acacia wood, and cover them with gold, so that the table may be transported using them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.decoded: And you shall make its plates, its ladles, its pitchers, and its bowls for pouring offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the showbread on the table before me always.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.decoded: You are to make a lampstand of pure gold; the lampstand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its branches, its cups, its decorative knobs, and its blossoms shall all be made from the same piece.

verses.kjv: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.decoded: And six branches will extend from its sides; three branches of the lampstand from one side, and three branches of the lampstand from the other side:

verses.kjv: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.decoded: Three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with a decorative bud and a flower, were on one branch; and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with a decorative bud and a flower, were on the other branch.

verses.kjv: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
verses.decoded: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms, with their decorative knobs and their blossoms.

verses.kjv: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.decoded: And there shall be a decorative bud under each of the three pairs of branches that extend from the lampstand.

verses.kjv: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.decoded: The decorative buds and the branches belonging to it must be made from the same material as the main structure; the entire object is to be a single piece of pure gold, formed by hammering.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.decoded: And you shall make its seven lamps; and they are to light its lamps so that they may provide light in front of it.

verses.kjv: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.decoded: Its tongs, and its trays for collecting wick trimmings, must be made of pure gold.

verses.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.decoded: He is to make it, along with all these associated items, using about 75 pounds of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.decoded: And make sure that you construct them according to their design, which was shown to you on the mountain.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you are to make the tabernacle with ten curtains made from fine twisted linen, and blue, purple, and scarlet threads. You shall make them with skillfully embroidered cherubim.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.decoded: The length of each curtain will be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain will be four cubits; all of the curtains will have the same dimensions.

verses.kjv: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.decoded: The first five curtains are to be joined to one another, and the other five curtains are also to be joined to one another.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.decoded: You are to make blue loops along the edge of one curtain, from the finished edge where it connects; and similarly, you shall make them along the outermost edge of another curtain.

verses.kjv: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.decoded: You shall make fifty loops on the first curtain, and you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set of curtains, where they are joined;

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And you shall make fifty gold clasps, and join the curtains together with these clasps, so that it will form one tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.decoded: And you shall make curtains of goat hair to be a covering over the tabernacle; you shall make eleven curtains.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.decoded: Each curtain is to be thirty cubits long and four cubits wide; all eleven curtains are to have the same dimensions.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And you shall join five curtains together separately, and six curtains together separately, and you shall fold the sixth curtain in the front part of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.decoded: You are to make fifty loops along the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the first set of curtains, and fifty loops along the edge of the curtain that joins the second set.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.decoded: And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and join the tent together, so that it becomes one piece.

verses.kjv: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: The remaining portion of the tent's curtains, specifically the half-curtain that is left over, will hang down over the rear of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.decoded: And one cubit on one side, and one cubit on the other side, of the remaining length of the tent curtains, will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.
verses.decoded: You are to make a covering for the tent using ram skins that have been dyed red, and an additional covering on top of that, made from badger skins.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
verses.decoded: And you are to make upright planks for the tabernacle from acacia wood.

verses.kjv: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
verses.decoded: The length of each board will be ten cubits, and the width of each board will be one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: Each board shall have two tenons, arranged opposite one another. You shall make all the boards of the tabernacle in this manner.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.decoded: And you are to make the planks for the tabernacle, twenty planks for the south side, positioned towards the south.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.decoded: You are to make forty silver bases. These bases are to be placed under the twenty planks, with two bases supporting each plank for its two projecting parts.

verses.kjv: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
verses.decoded: For the second side of the tabernacle, which is the north side, there are to be twenty boards.

verses.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.decoded: And there were forty silver bases; two bases were placed under each wooden frame, and two bases were placed under every other wooden frame.

verses.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.decoded: And for the western end of the tabernacle, you shall make six planks.

verses.kjv: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.decoded: And you shall make two planks for the corners of the tabernacle on the two sides.

verses.kjv: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.decoded: And they will be joined together at the bottom, and they will be joined together at the top, at its head, into a single ring. This is how it will be for both of them; they will serve as the two corner pieces.

verses.kjv: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.decoded: There will be eight planks, each with two silver bases, making a total of sixteen bases; two bases will be placed under each plank.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.decoded: And you are to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

verses.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.decoded: And five crossbars for the planks on the second long side of the tabernacle, and five crossbars for the planks on the third long side of the tabernacle, for the two sides that face west.

verses.kjv: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.decoded: And the central crossbar, located in the middle of the wooden frames, will extend from one end to the other.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.decoded: And you shall cover the planks with gold, and make gold rings on them to hold the crossbars, and you shall cover the crossbars with gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.decoded: And you are to set up the tabernacle according to its design which was shown to you on the mountain.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
verses.decoded: And you shall make a curtain from blue, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen, expertly crafted; it shall be made with cherubim.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
verses.decoded: And you shall hang it on four posts made of acacia wood, covered with gold. Their hooks will be made of gold, resting on four silver bases.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.decoded: And you shall hang the curtain under the clasps, so that you may bring in there, behind the curtain, the Ark of the Covenant; and the curtain will separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the atonement cover on top of the ark of the covenant in the holiest part of the sanctuary.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.decoded: You are to place the table outside the curtain, and the lampstand opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle. You are to put the table on the north side.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
verses.decoded: And you shall make a curtain for the entrance of the tent, from blue, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen, skillfully embroidered.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.decoded: You are to make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, and cover them with gold; their hooks are to be made of gold, and you are to cast five bronze bases for them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
verses.decoded: You are to construct an altar using acacia wood. It is to be five cubits in length and five cubits in width, making it square. Its height shall be three cubits.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.decoded: And you shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of the same piece, and you shall cover it with bronze.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
verses.decoded: And you shall make its pots for collecting its ashes, along with its shovels, its bowls, its meat hooks, and its firepans; all of these are its utensils.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.decoded: And you shall make for it a grid-like structure of bronze mesh; and on this mesh you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
verses.decoded: And you shall place it below the rim of the altar, so that the grating extends to the middle of the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.decoded: And you are to make poles for the altar, specifically poles made from acacia wood, and cover them with bronze.

verses.kjv: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
verses.decoded: And the poles must be inserted into the rings, and these poles must rest along the two sides of the altar, in order to carry it.

verses.kjv: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
verses.decoded: You are to construct it hollow, using boards, exactly as it was shown to you on the mountain; in that same manner, they shall construct it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
verses.decoded: You are to make the courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side, there shall be curtains for the courtyard made of fine twisted linen, one hundred cubits long for that side.

verses.kjv: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.decoded: And its twenty posts and their twenty bases will be made of bronze; the hooks for the posts and their connecting rods will be made of silver.

verses.kjv: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.decoded: And similarly, for the north side, along its length, there will be curtains one hundred cubits long, along with its twenty posts and their twenty bronze bases.

verses.kjv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.decoded: And for the width of the courtyard on the west side, there shall be curtains that are fifty cubits long, with ten pillars and ten bases for them.

verses.kjv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.decoded: And the width of the courtyard on its eastern side will be fifty cubits.

verses.kjv: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.decoded: The curtains for one side of the gateway are to be fifteen cubits long; they will have three supporting posts and three bases for these posts.

verses.kjv: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.decoded: And on the other side there shall be curtains, fifteen cubits long, with three supporting pillars and three bases for those pillars.

verses.kjv: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
verses.decoded: And for the gate of the courtyard, there shall be a curtain twenty cubits long, made of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine twisted linen, crafted with needlework.

verses.kjv: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.decoded: All the columns surrounding the courtyard will be adorned with silver bands; their hooks will be made of silver, and their bases will be made of bronze.

verses.kjv: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.decoded: The courtyard's length will be one hundred cubits, its width will be fifty cubits throughout, and its height will be five cubits, made of fine woven linen, with its bases made of bronze.

verses.kjv: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.decoded: All the equipment of the tabernacle for all its functions, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the courtyard, must be made of bronze.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
verses.decoded: And you are to command the Israelites that they bring to you pure olive oil, pressed, for the light, so that the lamp may burn continuously.

verses.kjv: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
