verses.decoded: Inside the Tent of Meeting, outside the curtain that is in front of the Ark of the Covenant, Aaron and his sons are to maintain the lamps from evening until morning in the presence of the Lord. This is to be a permanent regulation for their descendants on behalf of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
verses.decoded: And bring your brother Aaron, along with his sons, from among the Israelites, so that he may serve me as a priest, specifically Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, who are Aaron's sons.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
verses.decoded: You are to make sacred garments for your brother Aaron, for his honor and for his adornment.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: And you shall speak to all who are skilled, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, so that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may serve me in the priest's office.

verses.kjv: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: These are the specific garments that are to be made: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, an intricately woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to construct these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that he may perform his duties as a priest for me.

verses.kjv: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.decoded: They are to use gold, blue, purple, and scarlet threads, along with fine linen.

verses.kjv: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
verses.decoded: They are to construct the ephod using gold, blue, purple, and scarlet threads, along with fine woven linen, all crafted with expert skill.

verses.kjv: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
verses.decoded: It will have its two shoulder pieces connected at its two ends; in this way, it will be joined together.

verses.kjv: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.decoded: The skillfully crafted waistband of the ephod, which is on it, shall be made of the same materials and with the same craftsmanship as the ephod; specifically, of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet threads, and fine twisted linen.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: And you are to take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:

verses.kjv: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.decoded: Six of their names were to be engraved on one stone, and the remaining six names of the others on the second stone, arranged in the order of their birth.

verses.kjv: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
verses.decoded: You shall engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel, using the technique of a stone engraver, similar to how a signet seal is engraved.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.decoded: And you are to place the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the children of Israel, and Aaron will carry their names before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
verses.decoded: Also, you shall make settings of gold.

verses.kjv: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
verses.decoded: You are to make two chains of pure gold, fashioned from braided cords, and attach these braided chains to the gold settings.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.decoded: You are to make the breastpiece for making decisions with skillful craftsmanship; you shall construct it in the same way as the ephod, using gold, blue, and purple materials.

verses.kjv: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
verses.decoded: It must be square when it is folded in half; its length will be one span, and its width will be one span.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
verses.decoded: And you are to mount stones on it, specifically four rows of stones. The first row will consist of a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle; this will be the first row.

verses.kjv: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.decoded: And the second row will consist of an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.kjv: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.decoded: And the third row contained a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.kjv: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
verses.decoded: And the fourth row will contain a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper; these stones are to be mounted in gold settings.

verses.kjv: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.decoded: And the stones will bear the names of the sons of Israel, twelve in number, corresponding to their names, engraved like a seal; each stone will have the name of one of the twelve tribes.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.decoded: And you shall make chains on the breastplate at the ends, made of braided work of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.decoded: And you are to make two gold rings on the breastplate, and you are to put these two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the two braided chains made of gold into the two rings that are on the edges of the breastplate.

verses.kjv: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
verses.decoded: And the other two ends of the two braided chains you shall fasten into the two settings, and place them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, at its front.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
verses.decoded: You are to make two rings of gold and attach them to the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is on the inner side of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.decoded: You shall make two additional gold rings and place them on the two sides of the ephod, underneath, toward its front part, opposite each other.

verses.kjv: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.decoded: They are to fasten the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it rests above the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod, and so that the breastplate will not come loose from the ephod.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
verses.decoded: And Aaron will carry the names of the sons of Israel on the breastplate of judgment over his heart, when he enters the holy place, as a constant reminder before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
verses.decoded: You shall place the Urim and the Thummim into the breastplate of judgment; and they shall be positioned over Aaron's heart when he goes into the presence of the LORD. Thus, Aaron will continuously carry the means of discerning the will of the LORD for the Israelites over his heart in the LORD's presence.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.decoded: You shall make the robe that is worn with the ephod entirely of blue material.

verses.kjv: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
verses.decoded: The opening for the head should be in the center of it. There should be a woven border around this opening, like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it does not tear.

verses.kjv: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
verses.decoded: And on the lower edge of the garment, you shall make decorative pomegranates from blue, purple, and scarlet threads, placed all around its edge; and golden bells shall be placed between these pomegranates, also all around the edge.

verses.kjv: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
verses.decoded: There was to be a golden bell and a pomegranate, then another golden bell and a pomegranate, all around the lower edge of the robe.

verses.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
verses.decoded: Aaron must wear it when he performs his priestly duties, and the sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the holy place before the Lord and when he exits, so that he does not die.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.decoded: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the inscription on a seal, 'SACRED TO THE LORD'.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.decoded: And you are to fasten it with a blue cord, so that it can be placed on the turban; it is to be positioned on the very front of the turban.

verses.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.decoded: And it will be on Aaron's forehead, so that Aaron may take responsibility for any wrongdoing related to the sacred offerings that the Israelites dedicate in all their holy gifts; and it will always be on his forehead, so that these offerings may be accepted before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
verses.decoded: And you shall skillfully decorate the tunic made of high-quality linen fabric with needlework, and you shall construct the turban from high-quality linen fabric, and you shall fashion the sash with intricate embroidery.

verses.kjv: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.decoded: And for Aaron's sons, you shall make tunics, and you shall make sashes for them, and you shall make head coverings for them, for dignity and for adornment.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: You are to put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons with him. Then you must anoint them, ordain them, and set them apart as holy, so that they may serve me as priests.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
verses.decoded: You shall make them linen undergarments to cover their private parts; they must extend from the waist to the thighs.

verses.kjv: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
verses.decoded: And these garments must be worn by Aaron and his sons when they enter the Tent of Meeting, or when they approach the altar to perform their duties in the holy area, so that they do not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent regulation for him and for his descendants after him.

verses.kjv: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
verses.decoded: This is what you must do to set them apart for sacred service, so they can serve me as priests: Take one young bull, and two rams that are perfect,

verses.kjv: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.decoded: You shall make them from wheat flour: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers brushed with oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.decoded: And you shall place them into a single basket, and bring them in that basket, along with the young bull and the two male sheep.

verses.kjv: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.decoded: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and you shall wash them with water.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
verses.decoded: You shall take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod itself, and the breastplate, and fasten him with the skillfully crafted belt of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.decoded: Then you are to take the anointing oil, pour it onto his head, and anoint him.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
verses.decoded: Then you are to bring his sons and put tunics on them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.decoded: You shall dress Aaron and his sons with sashes, and place head coverings on them. The priestly role will belong to them as a permanent law, and you shall officially appoint Aaron and his sons.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.decoded: And you are to bring a young bull before the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to place their hands on the head of the young bull.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And you shall slaughter the young bull in the presence of the Lord, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
verses.decoded: And you shall take some of the blood from the young bull, and apply it to the projections (horns) of the altar using your finger, and pour the remaining blood at the base of the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
verses.decoded: You shall take all the fat that covers the internal organs, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

verses.kjv: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
verses.decoded: However, the meat of the young bull, along with its hide and its waste, you must burn with fire outside the designated area of the camp, because it is an offering for sin.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.decoded: You shall also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
verses.decoded: Then you are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and sprinkle it all around on the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
verses.decoded: And you shall cut the ram into pieces, and wash its internal organs and its legs, and place them with its other pieces and with its head.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: You are to burn the entire male sheep on the altar. This is a burnt offering dedicated to the Lord; it is a pleasing aroma, an offering presented by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.decoded: And you are to take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands on the head of the ram.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.decoded: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and on the lobe of his sons' right ears, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood around the altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.decoded: You are to take some of the blood that is on the altar and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, on his garments, on his sons, and on the garments of his sons who are with him. Then he will be consecrated, along with his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons who are with him.

verses.kjv: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
verses.decoded: You must also take from the ram the fat and the fatty tail, the fat covering the internal organs, the fatty membrane over the liver, the two kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh; because it is a ram for ordination: along with one loaf of bread, one cake made with oil, and one thin wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is placed before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
verses.decoded: And one loaf of bread, and one cake made with oil, and one thin, flat bread from the basket of unleavened bread that is placed before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.decoded: And you shall place all of these into the hands of Aaron and into the hands of his sons; and you shall present them as a wave offering before the Lord.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: You shall take them from their hands and burn them on the altar as a burnt offering, as a pleasing aroma before the Lord; it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
verses.decoded: And you are to take the breast portion of the ram used for Aaron's ordination, and present it as a wave offering before the Lord; and it will be your designated portion.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
verses.decoded: And you shall set apart as holy the breast from the ram's wave offering, which is presented by waving, and the shoulder from the ram's heave offering, which is presented by lifting up.

verses.kjv: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: This portion will belong to Aaron and his sons as a permanent regulation from the Israelites, because it is a raised offering. It will be a raised offering from the Israelites, taken from the sacrifice of their peace offerings, specifically their raised offering to the Lord.

verses.kjv: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.decoded: Aaron's sacred garments will belong to his sons who succeed him, so that they may be anointed and officially dedicated while wearing them.

verses.kjv: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
verses.decoded: And the son who serves as priest in his place shall wear them for seven days, when he comes into the tent of meeting to perform his duties in the holy area.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
verses.decoded: And you shall take the ram designated for the ordination, and boil its meat in the sacred area.

verses.kjv: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat from the ram and the bread that is in the basket, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
verses.decoded: They are to eat the offerings through which reconciliation was made, in order to set them apart and make them holy. However, an unauthorized person must not eat of these, because they are sacred.

verses.kjv: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.decoded: And if any of the meat from the consecration offerings, or any of the bread, remains until the morning, then you must burn the rest with fire; it must not be eaten, because it is holy.

verses.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.decoded: And you shall do this to Aaron and his sons, according to everything I have commanded you: for seven days you shall consecrate them.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.decoded: And you are to offer a young bull each day as a sin offering for purification. And you are to cleanse the altar after you have made purification for it, and you are to anoint it to make it holy.

verses.kjv: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.decoded: For seven days, you must perform a ritual of purification for the altar and dedicate it for sacred use; then it will become an extremely sacred altar, and anything that touches this altar will also become sacred.

verses.kjv: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.decoded: Now, this is what you are to offer on the altar: two lambs, each one year old, every day without interruption.

verses.kjv: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
verses.decoded: You shall offer one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb in the evening.

verses.kjv: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
verses.decoded: Along with the single lamb, there shall be one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed olive oil, and one-fourth of a hin of wine as a liquid offering.

verses.kjv: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: You are to offer the second lamb in the evening, and you shall prepare it with the grain offering of the morning and its drink offering.

verses.kjv: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.decoded: This will be a regular burnt offering for all your future generations at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, in the presence of the Lord, where I will encounter you to speak to you there.

verses.kjv: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.decoded: And in that place, I will encounter the people of Israel, and the portable sanctuary will be made holy by my divine presence.

verses.kjv: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: And I will make holy the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also make holy both Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve me in their priestly role.

verses.kjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.decoded: And I will reside among the people of Israel, and I will be their God.

verses.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
verses.decoded: And they will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, so that I may live among them: I am the Lord their God.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
verses.decoded: And you shall make an altar on which to burn incense; you shall make it from acacia wood.

verses.kjv: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
verses.decoded: Its length is to be one cubit, and its width one cubit; it must be square. Its height is to be two cubits, and its projections (horns) must be made from the same piece of material.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.decoded: And you shall cover it with pure gold, its top, and its sides all around, and its projections; and you shall make a decorative border of gold all around it.

verses.kjv: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.decoded: You are to make two golden rings for it, placing them beneath its decorative molding, at its two corners. You shall position these rings on its two sides, and they will serve as holders for the poles used to carry it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.decoded: And you shall make the poles from acacia wood, and cover them with gold.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
verses.decoded: And you shall place it in front of the curtain that is near the Ark of the Covenant, in front of the atonement cover that is above the tablets of the covenant, where I will meet with you.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
verses.decoded: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning; when he prepares the lamps, he is to burn incense on it.

verses.kjv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
verses.decoded: And when Aaron lights the lamps in the evening, he must burn incense on it, a continuous offering of incense before the Lord for all your future generations.

verses.kjv: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
verses.decoded: You must not offer any unauthorized incense on it, nor a burnt offering, nor a grain offering; neither shall you pour a drink offering on it.

verses.kjv: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And Aaron must perform a ritual of reconciliation on its horns once every year, using the blood from the offering made to cleanse from sin. He must do this once every year.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
verses.decoded: When you take a census of the Israelites, each person counted must give a payment for his life to the Lord when you count them, so that no disaster will strike them when you count them.

verses.kjv: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Each person who is counted in the census must give this: half a shekel, according to the standard weight of the sanctuary shekel. (A shekel is equivalent to twenty gerahs.)

verses.kjv: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Everyone who is counted in the census, from twenty years old and older, must give an offering to the Lord.

verses.kjv: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.decoded: Wealthy individuals must not contribute more, and those with limited means must not contribute less than half a shekel, when they present a contribution to the Lord, to provide expiation for your lives.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.decoded: And you shall take the money for reconciliation from the people of Israel, and you shall designate it for the service of the Tent of Meeting, so that it may be a reminder for the people of Israel before the Lord, to provide reconciliation for your lives.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
verses.decoded: You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its stand of bronze, for washing. And you shall place it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

verses.kjv: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.decoded: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and their feet at that place.

verses.kjv: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
verses.decoded: When they enter the Tent of Meeting, they must wash with water so that they do not die; or when they approach the altar to perform their duties, to burn an offering made by fire to the Lord, they must wash with water so that they do not die.

verses.kjv: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
verses.decoded: Therefore, they must wash their hands and their feet so that they do not die. This will be a permanent regulation for them, specifically for him and his descendants throughout all their generations.

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: Furthermore, the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:

verses.kjv: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
verses.decoded: You are also to take the finest spices: five hundred shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much—two hundred and fifty shekels—of fragrant cinnamon, and two hundred and fifty shekels of fragrant calamus,

verses.kjv: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
verses.decoded: And five hundred shekels of cassia, measured according to the standard weight of the sanctuary, and one hin of olive oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
verses.decoded: And you shall make it a sacred anointing oil, an ointment skillfully prepared by a perfumer: it shall be a sacred anointing oil.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.decoded: And you shall anoint the Tent of Meeting with it, along with the Ark of the Covenant.

verses.kjv: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.decoded: And the table with all its utensils, and the lampstand with all its implements, and the altar of incense,

verses.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
verses.decoded: And the altar for burnt offerings with all its utensils, and the basin and its stand.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.decoded: And you are to consecrate them, so that they may be utterly sacred: whatever touches them will become holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: You are to anoint Aaron and his sons and dedicate them, so that they may serve me in their role as priests.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
verses.decoded: And you must tell the people of Israel, saying, 'This will be a sacred anointing oil for me for all your future generations.'

verses.kjv: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
verses.decoded: It must not be poured on human skin, nor shall you make anything else like it, following its specific mixture. It is sacred, and it shall remain sacred to you.

verses.kjv: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.decoded: Anyone who prepares a similar mixture, or anyone who applies any of it to an unauthorized person, will be expelled from their community.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take for yourself fragrant spices: stacte, onycha, and galbanum. These fragrant spices, along with pure frankincense, must each be of equal weight."

verses.kjv: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
verses.decoded: You are to make it into incense, a fragrant mixture prepared by a perfumer, thoroughly blended, pure and sacred.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
verses.decoded: And you shall grind some of it into a very fine powder, and place some of it in front of the covenant tablets in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you; it shall be most sacred to you.

verses.kjv: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
verses.decoded: Regarding the incense that you are to prepare, you must not make any for yourselves using its specific formula; it is to be considered sacred to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.decoded: Anyone who makes anything similar to it for its fragrance will certainly be expelled from his community.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.decoded: Look, I have specifically chosen Bezalel, the son of Uri, who was the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.

verses.kjv: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.decoded: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, giving him wisdom, understanding, and knowledge, and skill in all kinds of craftsmanship.

verses.kjv: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.decoded: To design intricate works, to work with gold, and with silver, and with bronze,

verses.kjv: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.decoded: And in cutting stones to set them, and in carving wood, to perform all kinds of skilled craftsmanship.

verses.kjv: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
verses.decoded: And look, I have also given him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan. And into the minds of all who are skilled, I have placed wisdom so that they can create everything I have instructed you to make.

verses.kjv: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
verses.decoded: The Tent of Meeting, and the chest containing the covenant, and the atonement cover that is on it, and all the equipment for the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
verses.decoded: And the table with its associated equipment, and the pure lampstand with all its associated equipment, and the altar for burning incense,

verses.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
verses.decoded: And the altar for burnt offerings with all its equipment, and the washing basin and its stand.

verses.kjv: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
verses.decoded: And the special woven garments for service, and the sacred clothing for Aaron, the priest, and the clothing for his sons, to perform their duties as priests.

verses.kjv: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
verses.decoded: And the anointing oil, and the fragrant incense for the holy place: they must make them exactly as I have commanded you.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
verses.decoded: You must also speak to the people of Israel, telling them, 'Indeed, you must observe my Sabbaths, because it is a distinguishing mark between me and you for all your future generations.'

verses.kjv: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must observe the Sabbath, because it is sacred to you. Anyone who desecrates it will certainly be put to death. Indeed, whoever performs any work on it, that person will be removed from among their people.

verses.kjv: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: For six days, work may be performed; but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, dedicated to the LORD. Anyone who performs any work on the Sabbath day will certainly be put to death.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the descendants of Israel are to observe the Sabbath, to keep the Sabbath throughout all their future generations, as an everlasting covenant.

verses.kjv: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
verses.decoded: This serves as a perpetual sign between me and the people of Israel, because in six days the Lord created the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he ceased from work and was renewed.

verses.kjv: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.decoded: And He gave to Moses, when He had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, two tablets containing the covenant, which were stone tablets, inscribed by God Himself.

verses.kjv: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.decoded: When the people saw that Moses was taking a long time to come down from the mountain, they assembled around Aaron and said to him, 'Come, make us gods who will lead us; because as for this Moses, the man who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.'

verses.kjv: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
verses.decoded: Then Aaron said to them, 'Remove the gold earrings that are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me.'

verses.kjv: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
verses.decoded: And all the people broke off the gold earrings that were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.

verses.kjv: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: And he took the gold from their hands and shaped it with an engraving tool, after he had made it into a molten calf. Then they said, 'These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
verses.decoded: When Aaron saw the golden calf, he built an altar in front of it. Then Aaron made a public announcement, saying, "Tomorrow will be a festival dedicated to the Lord."

verses.kjv: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.decoded: And they got up early the next day, and presented burnt sacrifices, and brought fellowship offerings; and the people sat down to eat and drink, and then got up to engage in revelry.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, 'Go down, because your people, whom you brought out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.'

verses.kjv: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: They have quickly deviated from the path I commanded them to follow. They have made for themselves a calf idol cast from metal, and they have bowed down to worship it, and have offered sacrifices to it, and have declared, 'These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, "I have observed this group of people, and indeed, they are a stubborn and disobedient people."

verses.kjv: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
verses.decoded: So now, leave me alone, so that my anger may become intense against them, and so that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation.

verses.kjv: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
verses.decoded: And Moses pleaded with the LORD his God, saying, 'LORD, why does your anger burn so fiercely against your people, whom you brought out of the land of Egypt?'

verses.kjv: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
verses.decoded: Why should the Egyptians say, 'He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth'?

verses.kjv: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.decoded: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your very being, and said to them, 'I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give all this land that I have promised to your descendants, and they will inherit it permanently.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
verses.decoded: And the Lord changed his mind about the disaster he planned to bring upon his people.

verses.kjv: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.decoded: And Moses turned and descended from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand. The tablets were inscribed on both their surfaces.

verses.kjv: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
verses.decoded: The stone tablets were made by God, and the inscriptions on them were also from God, carved into the tablets.

verses.kjv: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.decoded: When Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting, he said to Moses, 'There is the sound of war in the camp.'

verses.kjv: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
verses.decoded: And he said, 'It is not the sound of those who shout in victory, nor is it the sound of those who cry out in defeat; but I hear the sound of those who are singing.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.decoded: And it happened that as soon as he approached the camp, he saw the idol in the shape of a calf and the dancing. Moses' anger became intense, and he threw the stone tablets from his hands, breaking them at the base of the mountain.

verses.kjv: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
verses.decoded: And he took the calf that they had made, and burned it in the fire, and ground it into a powder, and scattered it over the water, and made the Israelites drink it.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.decoded: Then Moses asked Aaron, "What did these people do to you, that you have caused such a great sin to come upon them?"

verses.kjv: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
verses.decoded: And Aaron said, 'My lord, do not let your anger become intense; you know the people, that they are inclined to do wrong.'

verses.kjv: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.decoded: Because they said to me, 'Make gods for us that will lead us, because as for this Moses, the man who led us out of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.'

verses.kjv: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.decoded: And I said to them, 'Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.' So they gave it to me; then I threw it into the fire, and this calf came out.

verses.kjv: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
verses.decoded: And when Moses saw that the people were unrestrained; (for Aaron had allowed them to become unrestrained, leading to their disgrace among their adversaries:)

verses.kjv: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.decoded: Then Moses stood at the entrance of the camp and said, 'Who supports the Lord? Let that person come to me.' And all the descendants of Levi assembled themselves with him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Each man is to put his sword by his side, and go back and forth from one gate to the other throughout the camp, and kill his brother, his friend, and his neighbor."

verses.kjv: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.decoded: And the descendants of Levi acted in accordance with Moses' instructions: and approximately three thousand people died among the people that day.

verses.kjv: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.decoded: Because Moses had commanded, 'Dedicate yourselves to the Lord today, specifically each man against his own son and against his own brother, so that He may grant you a blessing today.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
verses.decoded: The next day, Moses said to the people, 'You have committed a great sin; now I will go up to the Lord, perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.'

verses.kjv: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.decoded: Then Moses returned to the Lord and said, 'Oh, these people have committed a grave sin, for they have made for themselves gods of gold.'

verses.kjv: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
verses.decoded: But now, if you are willing to forgive their sin; and if not, please erase my name from your book that you have written.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, 'Whoever has sinned against me, I will erase that person from my record.'

verses.kjv: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.decoded: So now go, lead the people to the place about which I have told you. Look, my Angel will go before you. However, on the day when I intervene, I will hold them accountable for their sin.

verses.kjv: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.decoded: So the Lord punished the people because they made the calf, which Aaron had made.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, 'Leave this place, and go up from here, you and the people whom you have led out of the land of Egypt, to the land which I promised with an oath...'

verses.kjv: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.decoded: And I will send a messenger ahead of you; and I will expel the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.kjv: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
verses.decoded: To a land abundant with milk and honey; because I will not go among you, for you are a stubborn people, otherwise I might destroy you on the journey.

verses.kjv: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.decoded: When the people heard this bad news, they grieved, and no one wore their ornaments.

verses.kjv: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
verses.decoded: Because the LORD had told Moses, 'Tell the people of Israel, "You are a stubborn people. I could come among you suddenly and destroy you."'

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.decoded: And the descendants of Israel removed their decorative items near Mount Horeb.

verses.kjv: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
verses.decoded: Moses took the portable sanctuary and set it up outside the main encampment, a considerable distance away from the camp, and he named it the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And it happened that whenever Moses went out to the Tent of Meeting, all the people would stand up, and each person would stand at the entrance of their tent, and they would watch Moses until he had entered the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.
verses.decoded: And it happened that as Moses went into the tent of meeting, the pillar of cloud came down and stood at the entrance of the tent, and the Lord spoke with Moses.

verses.kjv: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.decoded: And all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tabernacle: and all the people stood up and worshipped, each person at the entrance of their own tent.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses directly, just as one person speaks to another. Moses then returned to the camp, but his assistant Joshua, son of Nun, a young man, remained within the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
verses.decoded: Moses said to the Lord, 'Look, you are telling me to lead these people, yet you have not informed me who you will send with me.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
verses.decoded: So now, I ask you, if I have found favor in your eyes, show me your ways so that I may know you and continue to find favor in your eyes; and consider that this nation is your people.

verses.kjv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
verses.decoded: And He said, My personal presence will go with you, and I will provide you with rest.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, If your presence does not go with me, do not take us up from here.

verses.kjv: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: For how will it be known here that I and your people have found favor in your sight? Is it not by your going with us? In this way, I and your people will be distinguished from all the other people who are on the face of the earth.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, I will also do this thing that you have spoken about, because you have found favor with me, and I know you personally.

verses.kjv: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
verses.decoded: And he said, I implore you, show me your glory.

verses.kjv: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.decoded: And he said, I will cause all my goodness to pass before you, and I will declare the name of the LORD before you; and I will show favor to whomever I choose to show favor, and I will show compassion to whomever I choose to show compassion.

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.decoded: And he said, You cannot see my face, because no human being can see me and continue to live.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
verses.decoded: And the Lord said, 'Look, there is a place near me, and you shall stand upon a rock.'

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verses.decoded: And it will happen that, as my glory passes by, I will place you in a crevice of the rock and cover you with my hand as I pass by.

verses.kjv: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.decoded: Then I will remove my hand, and you will see my back; however, my face will not be visible.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to Moses, 'Cut for yourself two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on these tablets the words that were on the first tablets.'

verses.kjv: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
verses.decoded: And be prepared by morning, and ascend Mount Sinai in the morning, and appear before me there on the summit of the mountain.

verses.kjv: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
verses.decoded: And no one is to come up with you, nor is anyone to be seen anywhere on the mountain; nor are flocks or herds to graze in front of that mountain.

verses.kjv: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
verses.decoded: So he cut out two stone tablets, just like the first ones. Then Moses got up early in the morning and went up Mount Sinai, as the LORD had instructed him, carrying the two stone tablets in his hand.

verses.kjv: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
verses.decoded: And the Lord came down in the cloud, and stood there with him, and announced the Lord's name.

verses.kjv: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verses.decoded: And the Lord went past him and announced, 'The Lord, the Lord God, full of compassion and kindness, very patient, and rich in loyal love and faithfulness.'

verses.kjv: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
verses.decoded: Maintaining faithful love for thousands, forgiving wrongdoing, rebellion, and error, but by no means acquitting the guilty; holding children and grandchildren responsible for the wrongdoing of their parents, to the third and fourth generation.

verses.kjv: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.decoded: And Moses quickly lowered his head to the ground and worshipped.

verses.kjv: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O LORD, let my LORD, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
verses.decoded: And he said, If I have now found favor in your sight, O Lord, I ask that my Lord would go among us, because they are a stubborn people; and forgive our wrongdoing and our sin, and accept us as your own possession.

verses.kjv: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
verses.decoded: And he said, 'Pay attention, I am establishing a solemn agreement. In the presence of all your people, I will perform extraordinary acts, such as have not been accomplished anywhere on earth, nor in any other nation.'

verses.kjv: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.decoded: Pay attention to what I am commanding you today: indeed, I am expelling from before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

verses.kjv: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
verses.decoded: Be careful not to make an agreement with the people who live in the land where you are going, so that it does not become a trap among you.

verses.kjv: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
verses.decoded: But you must destroy their altars, break their sacred pillars, and cut down their Asherah poles.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
verses.decoded: Indeed, you must worship no other god, because the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a God who demands exclusive devotion.

verses.kjv: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
verses.decoded: Be careful not to make a treaty with the people living in the land. If you do, when they act unfaithfully by pursuing their gods and offering sacrifices to their gods, and one of them invites you, you might eat from his sacrifice.

verses.kjv: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
verses.decoded: And you take some of their daughters as wives for your sons, and then their daughters will pursue other gods, and cause your sons to pursue their gods.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
verses.decoded: You shall not make for yourself any gods made from melted metal.

verses.kjv: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
verses.decoded: You must observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days, you must eat bread made without yeast, just as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib, because in the month of Abib you departed from Egypt.

verses.kjv: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
verses.decoded: Every firstborn creature belongs to me; and every firstborn male among your livestock, whether ox or sheep.

verses.kjv: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
verses.decoded: However, the firstborn of a donkey you must redeem by substituting a lamb. If you do not redeem it, then you must break its neck. You must also redeem all the firstborn of your sons.

verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
verses.decoded: For six days you are to work, but on the seventh day you must rest; even during the time of plowing and harvesting, you must rest.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.
verses.decoded: And you must observe the Feast of Weeks, which celebrates the first produce of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year.

verses.kjv: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the LORD God, the God of Israel.
verses.decoded: Three times a year, all your male descendants must present themselves before the Lord God, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.
verses.decoded: Because I will drive out the nations from before you and expand your territory, no one will covet your land when you go up to present yourselves before the LORD your God three times a year.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
verses.decoded: You must not offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything containing yeast; nor shall the animal sacrifice of the Passover festival be allowed to remain until the next morning.

verses.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
verses.decoded: You must bring the very first and best produce from your land to the temple of the Lord your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to Moses, Write down these words: because according to these words I have made a solemn agreement with you and with Israel.

verses.kjv: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
verses.decoded: And he remained there with the Lord for forty days and forty nights; he consumed neither food nor water. And he inscribed upon the stone tablets the terms of the agreement, the Ten Commandments.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
verses.decoded: It happened that when Moses descended from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of testimony in his hand, as he came down from the mountain, Moses was unaware that the skin of his face was radiant because he had been speaking with God.

verses.kjv: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
verses.decoded: And when Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, indeed, the skin of his face was radiant; and they were afraid to come near him.

verses.kjv: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
verses.decoded: Moses called to them; and Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him: and Moses spoke with them.

verses.kjv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.decoded: And after that, all the Israelites approached, and he commanded them everything that the Lord had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

verses.kjv: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
verses.decoded: And when Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

verses.kjv: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
verses.decoded: However, when Moses entered the presence of the Lord to speak with Him, he would remove the veil until he exited. And when he exited, he spoke to the Israelites what he had been commanded.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.decoded: And the Israelites saw Moses' face, that the skin of Moses' face was radiant; and Moses again placed the veil over his face until he went in to speak with God.

verses.kjv: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.
verses.decoded: Moses assembled the entire community of the Israelites and told them, 'These are the instructions that the LORD has commanded for you to follow.'

verses.kjv: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
verses.decoded: For six days, work may be performed, but the seventh day will be a sacred day for you, a Sabbath of complete rest dedicated to the Lord. Anyone who performs work on that day must be put to death.

verses.kjv: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.decoded: You must not start any fire in any of your homes on the Sabbath day.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke to the entire assembly of the people of Israel, saying, 'This is what the Lord has commanded:'

verses.kjv: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
