verses.decoded: From among yourselves, you are to take a contribution for the Lord. Whoever has a willing heart, let him bring it as a contribution to the Lord: gold, and silver, and bronze.

verses.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
verses.decoded: And blue material, and purple material, and scarlet material, and fine linen, and goat hair,

verses.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
verses.decoded: And ram skins dyed red, and badger skins, and acacia wood,

verses.kjv: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.decoded: And olive oil for the lamps, and aromatic spices for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

verses.kjv: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.decoded: And onyx stones, and other gemstones to be placed on the ephod and on the breastplate.

verses.kjv: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
verses.decoded: And every person among you who possesses skill and understanding shall come and construct everything that the LORD has commanded.

verses.kjv: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.decoded: And the dwelling place, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its frames, its crossbars, its posts, and its bases,

verses.kjv: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
verses.decoded: The ark, along with its carrying poles, the mercy seat, and the veil that served as a covering,

verses.kjv: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
verses.decoded: The table, along with its carrying poles, all its associated utensils, and the bread of the Presence,

verses.kjv: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.decoded: Also, the lampstand for illumination, along with its accessories, and its lamps, including the oil for the illumination.

verses.kjv: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
verses.decoded: the altar for burning incense, along with its carrying poles, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.decoded: The altar for burnt offerings, along with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils, as well as the washing basin and its stand.

verses.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
verses.decoded: The curtains for the courtyard, its posts, and their bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard,

verses.kjv: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
verses.decoded: The tent pegs for the tabernacle, and the tent pegs for the courtyard, along with their ropes,

verses.kjv: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: The special textiles for performing duties in the sacred area, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons, to serve in their roles as priests.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.decoded: And the entire community of the Israelites left Moses' presence.

verses.kjv: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
verses.decoded: And they came, every person whose inner desire motivated them, and every person whose spirit made them willing, and they brought the LORD's contribution for the construction of the Tent of Meeting, and for all its related tasks, and for the sacred clothing.

verses.kjv: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing in their hearts, and brought armbands, and earrings, and finger rings, and pendants, all ornaments made of gold.

verses.kjv: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought them.
verses.decoded: And every man who possessed blue, purple, and scarlet material, fine linen, goat hair, ram skins dyed red, and badger skins, brought them.

verses.kjv: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’s offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.decoded: Everyone who presented an offering of silver and bronze brought it as an offering to the Lord, and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work of the service, brought it.

verses.kjv: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.decoded: And all the women who were skilled and willing spun thread with their hands, and they brought what they had spun, which included blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, as well as fine linen.

verses.kjv: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ hair.
verses.decoded: And all the women whose hearts motivated them with skill spun goat's hair.

verses.kjv: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.decoded: And the leaders brought onyx stones, and other gemstones to be mounted, for the ephod and for the breastplate;

verses.kjv: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.decoded: And spices, and oil for illumination, and for the sacred anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

verses.kjv: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: All the Israelite men and women whose hearts prompted them to be willing brought voluntary offerings to the LORD for every kind of work.

verses.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.decoded: And Moses said to the Israelites, 'Look, the Lord has specifically chosen Bezaleel, son of Uri, son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah;'

verses.kjv: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.decoded: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, giving him wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and skill in every kind of craftsmanship.

verses.kjv: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.decoded: And to design intricate works, to craft items from gold, silver, and bronze,

verses.kjv: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
verses.decoded: And in cutting stones to mount them, and in carving wood to create all kinds of artistic craftsmanship.

verses.kjv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.decoded: And He has given him the skill to teach, both him and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan.

verses.kjv: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
verses.decoded: He has given them skill and understanding to do all kinds of work: as engravers, expert craftsmen, and embroiderers who work with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen; and as weavers—indeed, those who do any work and those who create intricate designs.

verses.kjv: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
verses.decoded: Then Bezalel and Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the Lord had given wisdom and understanding, performed all kinds of work.

verses.kjv: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
verses.decoded: And Moses summoned Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every skilled person whom the Lord had endowed with wisdom, everyone whose spirit moved them to come and perform the work.

verses.kjv: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
verses.decoded: And they accepted from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites had brought for the work of constructing the sanctuary, in order to build it with those materials.

verses.kjv: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
verses.decoded: So all the wise individuals who were doing all the work for the sanctuary came, each from the work he was doing,

verses.kjv: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
verses.decoded: And they spoke to Moses, saying, 'The people are bringing much more than enough for the work which the Lord commanded them to make.'

verses.kjv: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
verses.decoded: And Moses issued an order, and they had it announced throughout the camp, stating, 'Let no man or woman do any more work for the contributions to the sanctuary.'

verses.kjv: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
verses.decoded: Because the materials they possessed were enough for all the work required to build it, and in fact, there was an abundance.

verses.kjv: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
verses.decoded: And every skilled craftsman among those who performed the work for the tabernacle made ten curtains from fine, twisted linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet threads. He made them with skillfully embroidered cherubim.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
verses.decoded: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.

verses.kjv: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
verses.decoded: And he joined five of the curtains to one another, and he joined the other five curtains to one another.

verses.kjv: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.decoded: He made loops of blue material along the edge of one curtain, specifically at its finished edge for joining. Similarly, he made loops on the outermost edge of another curtain, also for joining.

verses.kjv: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
verses.decoded: He made fifty loops on one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the second curtain where it joined with the first. These loops connected the two curtains together.

verses.kjv: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
verses.decoded: He made fifty gold clasps and used them to join the curtains together, so that it became one tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
verses.decoded: And he constructed curtains from goat hair for the outer covering of the sacred tent; he made a total of eleven such curtains.

verses.kjv: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
verses.decoded: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain was four cubits; all eleven curtains had the same dimensions.

verses.kjv: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.decoded: And he joined five curtains together separately, and six curtains together separately.

verses.kjv: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.decoded: He made blue loops along the edge of one curtain, at the finished border where it was to be joined. Similarly, he made loops along the outermost edge of another curtain, at the point where it would be joined to the second set.

verses.kjv: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.decoded: And he made fifty bronze clasps to connect the tent together, so that it would be a single unit.

verses.kjv: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.
verses.decoded: He then made a covering for the tent from rams' skins that had been dyed red, and above that, he made another covering from badgers' skins.

verses.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
verses.decoded: And he constructed planks of acacia wood for the tabernacle, positioned upright.

verses.kjv: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
verses.decoded: Each board was ten cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.

verses.kjv: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: Each plank had two tenons, positioned at an equal distance from each other. This is how he constructed all the planks for the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
verses.decoded: And he constructed planks for the sacred tent; specifically, twenty planks for the southern side, facing south.

verses.kjv: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.decoded: He also made forty silver bases to be placed under the twenty wooden boards. For each board, there were two bases to receive its two projecting tenons.

verses.kjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
verses.decoded: And for the other side of the tabernacle, specifically the north corner, he constructed twenty planks.

verses.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.decoded: And there were forty silver bases; two bases were placed under each plank, and two bases were placed under another plank.

verses.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
verses.decoded: And for the western side of the tabernacle, he constructed six wooden planks.

verses.kjv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.decoded: He also made two planks for the corners of the tabernacle on its two sides.

verses.kjv: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
verses.decoded: And they were joined at the bottom, and joined together at their top ends, to a single ring; he did this for both of them in both corners.

verses.kjv: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
verses.decoded: There were eight planks, and they had sixteen silver bases, with two bases under each plank.

verses.kjv: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.decoded: He also made five bars of acacia wood for the planks on one side of the tabernacle,

verses.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
verses.decoded: And five crossbars for the planks on the other side of the tabernacle, and five crossbars for the planks of the tabernacle on the west side.

verses.kjv: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
verses.decoded: And he constructed the central crossbar to extend through the wooden frames from one end to the other.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.decoded: And he covered the wooden planks with gold, and he made golden rings on them to hold the crossbars, and he also covered the crossbars with gold.

verses.kjv: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
verses.decoded: And he made a curtain of blue, purple, and scarlet material, and finely woven linen. He skillfully crafted it with cherubs woven into its design.

verses.kjv: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
verses.decoded: And he made for it four posts of acacia wood, and covered them with gold. Their hooks were made of gold, and he molded for them four silver bases.

verses.kjv: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
verses.decoded: And he made a curtain for the entrance of the tabernacle, crafted from blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine twisted linen, all embroidered.

verses.kjv: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
verses.decoded: And the five posts for it, along with their hooks, were made. He covered their capitals and their connecting rods with gold, but their five bases were made of bronze.

verses.kjv: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
verses.decoded: Bezaleel constructed the ark from acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, its width was one and a half cubits, and its height was one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
verses.decoded: And he covered it with pure gold, both on the inside and on the outside, and he made a decorative border of gold around it.

verses.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
verses.decoded: He molded four gold rings for it, to be placed at its four corners; specifically, two rings on one side of it and two rings on the other side of it.

verses.kjv: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.decoded: He also made poles from acacia wood and covered them with gold.

verses.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.decoded: And he placed the poles into the rings along the sides of the ark, in order to carry the ark.

verses.kjv: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.decoded: And he constructed the atonement cover from solid gold: its length was two and a half cubits, and its width was one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
verses.decoded: And he made two cherubs of gold; he formed them by hammering a single piece of gold, placing them on the two ends of the mercy seat.

verses.kjv: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.decoded: He made one cherub at one end and another cherub at the other end; he fashioned the cherubim out of the mercy seat at its two ends.

verses.kjv: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
verses.decoded: And the cherubim extended their wings upward, and with their wings, they covered the atonement cover, with their faces turned toward each other, facing toward the atonement cover.

verses.kjv: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
verses.decoded: He also constructed the table from acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, its width was one cubit, and its height was one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
verses.decoded: And he covered it completely with pure gold, and made a decorative border of gold all around it.

verses.kjv: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
verses.decoded: Additionally, he made for it a border about a hand's width all around, and he made a decorative gold molding for that border all around.

verses.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
verses.decoded: And he fashioned for it four gold rings, and placed the rings on the four corners that were at its four feet.

verses.kjv: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.decoded: Next to the edge were the rings, which served as holders for the poles used to carry the table.

verses.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
verses.decoded: He also made poles from acacia wood and covered them with gold, for the purpose of carrying the table.

verses.kjv: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
verses.decoded: And he made the utensils that were for the table, including his dishes, his spoons, his bowls, and his covers for them, all from pure gold.

verses.kjv: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
verses.decoded: He made the lampstand from pure gold; he crafted the lampstand by hammering the gold, including its central stem, its branches, its decorative cups, its ornamental buds, and its blossoms.

verses.kjv: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
verses.decoded: And six branches extended from its sides; three branches of the lampstand came out from one side of it, and three branches of the lampstand came out from the other side of it.

verses.kjv: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.decoded: On one branch, there were three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with a bud and a flower. And on another branch, there were also three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with a bud and a flower.

verses.kjv: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
verses.decoded: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms, with their ornamental buds and their open flowers.

verses.kjv: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
verses.decoded: And an ornamental knob was placed beneath two branches of the lampstand, and another ornamental knob beneath two more branches of the lampstand, and a third ornamental knob beneath the final two branches of the lampstand, corresponding to the six branches extending from it.

verses.kjv: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.decoded: Their decorative knobs and their branches were all part of the same piece; the entire item was a single piece of pure gold, formed by hammering.

verses.kjv: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
verses.decoded: He also made its seven lamps, along with its wick trimmers and its trays for the trimmings, all from pure gold.

verses.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
verses.decoded: He made it and all its accessories from approximately seventy-five pounds of pure gold.

verses.kjv: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
verses.decoded: And he constructed the altar for burning incense from acacia wood. Its length was one cubit, and its width was one cubit; it was square. Its height was two cubits, and its projections (horns) were made from the same piece.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.decoded: He covered it with pure gold, including its top, its sides all around, and its corner projections. He also made a decorative molding of gold all around its edge.

verses.kjv: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.decoded: He also made two gold rings for it, positioned under its molding, at its two corners, on both of its sides, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry it.

verses.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.decoded: And he made the poles from acacia wood and covered them with gold.

verses.kjv: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
verses.decoded: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure incense from fragrant spices, crafted with the skill of a perfumer.

verses.kjv: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
verses.decoded: And he constructed the altar for burnt offerings from acacia wood; its length was five cubits, and its width was five cubits; it was square in shape.

verses.kjv: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
verses.decoded: He made horns on its four corners; these horns were an integral part of it, and he covered it with bronze.

verses.kjv: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
verses.decoded: He constructed all the utensils for the altar: the containers, the ash shovels, the bowls, the meat forks, and the incense pans. He made all these utensils from bronze.

verses.kjv: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
verses.decoded: He also made for the altar a bronze mesh grate, placing it under its rim, extending from below to its midpoint.

verses.kjv: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
verses.decoded: And he fashioned four rings for the four corners of the bronze grating, to serve as holders for the poles.

verses.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
verses.decoded: And he made the poles from acacia wood, and covered them with bronze.

verses.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
verses.decoded: And he inserted the poles into the rings located on the sides of the altar, in order to carry it; he constructed the altar to be hollow, using planks of wood.

verses.kjv: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: He constructed the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the bronze mirrors donated by the women who served and gathered at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
verses.decoded: He then constructed the courtyard. On the south side, the hangings for the courtyard were made of fine, twisted linen, measuring one hundred cubits in length.

verses.kjv: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.decoded: There were twenty of their pillars, and twenty of their bronze bases; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting rods were made of silver.

verses.kjv: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.decoded: And for the north side, the curtains were one hundred cubits long. There were twenty pillars and twenty bronze bases for them. The hooks of the pillars and their connecting rods were made of silver.

verses.kjv: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.decoded: For the west side, there were curtains fifty cubits long, with ten pillars and ten bases for them; the hooks on the pillars and their connecting rods were made of silver.

verses.kjv: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
verses.decoded: And for the east side, facing eastward, it was fifty cubits long.

verses.kjv: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.decoded: The curtains on one side of the gate measured fifteen cubits in length; they were supported by three pillars, which stood in three corresponding bases.

verses.kjv: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.decoded: And for the other side of the courtyard entrance, on both sides, there were curtains that were fifteen cubits long; they had three supporting posts and three bases.

verses.kjv: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
verses.decoded: All the curtains surrounding the courtyard were made of finely twisted linen.

verses.kjv: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.decoded: The bases for the posts were made of bronze; the hooks on the posts and their connecting rods were made of silver; and the covering on the tops of the posts was also made of silver;

verses.kjv: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.decoded: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was a piece of embroidered fabric, made from blue, purple, and scarlet yarns, and fine, tightly woven linen. Its length was twenty cubits, and its height was five cubits, matching the other curtains of the courtyard.

verses.kjv: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
verses.decoded: And there were four of their pillars, and four of their bases were made of bronze; their hooks were made of silver, and the covering of their capitals and their connecting rods were made of silver.

verses.kjv: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
verses.decoded: And all the stakes of the tabernacle, and of the surrounding courtyard, were made of bronze.

verses.kjv: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
verses.decoded: This is the accounting of the tabernacle, specifically the tabernacle of the covenant, as it was itemized according to Moses' command, for the duties of the Levites, under the supervision of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.

verses.kjv: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And Bezaleel, who was the son of Uri, and Uri was the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah, constructed everything that the Lord had instructed Moses to make.

verses.kjv: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.decoded: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skilled craftsman, and an embroiderer who worked with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.

verses.kjv: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.decoded: All the gold that was used for the construction work in the holy place, specifically the gold from the offering, totaled twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, measured by the standard sanctuary shekel.

verses.kjv: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.decoded: The silver from those who were counted in the community amounted to one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, measured by the standard sanctuary shekel.

verses.kjv: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
verses.decoded: Each man contributed a bekah, which is half a shekel according to the official standard of the sanctuary. This was for every person counted in the census, from twenty years old and above, totaling six hundred three thousand five hundred and fifty men.

verses.kjv: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.decoded: And from the one hundred talents of silver, the bases for the tabernacle and the bases for the curtain were cast; specifically, one hundred bases from the one hundred talents, with one talent used for each base.

verses.kjv: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
verses.decoded: And from the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, he made hooks for the pillars, and he covered the capitals of the pillars, and he decorated them with bands.

verses.kjv: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.decoded: The bronze that was contributed amounted to seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

verses.kjv: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.decoded: And with it, he constructed the bases for the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and the bronze altar, and its bronze grating, and all the utensils for the altar.

verses.kjv: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.decoded: And the bases for the surrounding courtyard, and the bases for the courtyard gate, and all the pegs for the tabernacle, and all the pegs for the surrounding courtyard.

verses.kjv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And from the blue, purple, and scarlet threads, they crafted special garments for performing duties in the sacred area, and they also made the holy clothing for Aaron, just as the LORD had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.decoded: And he crafted the ephod from gold, blue, purple, and scarlet threads, and finely woven linen.

verses.kjv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
verses.decoded: They hammered the gold into thin sheets and then cut it into threads. These gold threads were then skillfully woven into the blue, purple, and scarlet fabrics, as well as into the fine linen.

verses.kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.decoded: They made shoulder straps for it, to connect it; it was joined together by its two edges.

verses.kjv: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And the skillfully crafted sash of his ephod, which was on it, was made of the same materials and with the same workmanship; it was made of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine twisted linen.

verses.kjv: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And they fashioned onyx stones, set in gold settings, engraved with the names of the tribes of Israel, just as seals are engraved.

verses.kjv: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he placed them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, so that they would serve as stones of remembrance for the people of Israel, just as the LORD had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.decoded: And he made the chest piece with expert craftsmanship, similar to the construction of the ephod; using gold, blue, purple, and scarlet threads, and finely twisted linen.

verses.kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
verses.decoded: It was square in shape; they constructed the breastplate with two layers. Its length was one span, and its width was also one span, as it was folded.

verses.kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
verses.decoded: They then arranged in it four rows of gemstones. The first row consisted of a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle; this was the first row.

verses.kjv: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.decoded: The second row contained an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.kjv: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.decoded: And the third row contained a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.kjv: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.decoded: And the fourth row included a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These were securely fastened in gold settings.

verses.kjv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.decoded: The stones corresponded to the names of the children of Israel; there were twelve stones, each bearing one of their names, engraved like a signet ring.

verses.kjv: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.decoded: And they fashioned chains for the breastplate, at its ends, made of braided pure gold.

verses.kjv: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.decoded: They also made two gold settings and two gold rings, and they placed the two rings into the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.kjv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.decoded: And they placed the two twisted chains made of gold into the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

verses.kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.decoded: And the two ends of the two twisted chains were fastened into the two settings, and they placed them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, in front of it.

verses.kjv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.decoded: They fashioned two gold rings and attached them to the two ends of the breastplate, along its edge, on the inner side of the ephod.

verses.kjv: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.decoded: And they made two additional gold rings, and placed them on the two lower sides of the ephod, towards the front part of it, opposite where the other coupling was attached.

verses.kjv: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: They fastened the breastplate using its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it would be positioned above the intricately woven waistband of the ephod, and so that it would not become separated from the ephod.

verses.kjv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
verses.decoded: He made the robe of the ephod from woven fabric, and it was entirely blue.

verses.kjv: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.decoded: And there was an opening in the middle of the robe, like the opening for a coat of mail, with a reinforced edge around the opening, so that it would not tear.

verses.kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.decoded: And they made pomegranate-shaped decorations from blue, purple, and scarlet material, and from fine twisted linen, on the lower edges of the robe.

verses.kjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.decoded: They fashioned bells from solid gold and placed these bells in the spaces between the decorative pomegranates, along the lower edge of the priestly garment, encircling the entire hem, alternating with the pomegranates.

verses.kjv: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: There was a bell and a pomegranate, then another bell and another pomegranate, placed alternately all around the lower edge of the robe, which was to be worn for priestly service, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.decoded: And they made tunics of finely woven linen for Aaron and for his sons,

verses.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.decoded: And a head covering made of high-quality linen, and attractive caps made of high-quality linen, and linen undergarments made of finely twisted, high-quality linen.

verses.kjv: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And a sash made of finely twisted linen, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, crafted with embroidery; just as the Lord instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.decoded: They fashioned a plate of pure gold for the sacred crown and inscribed words upon it, in a manner similar to the engravings found on a seal, stating: 'Consecrated to the Lord.'

verses.kjv: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And they attached a blue cord to it, to secure it high upon the turban; just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.decoded: In this way, all the work on the tabernacle, which was the tent of meeting, was completed; and the Israelites did everything exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses; that is what they did.

verses.kjv: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.decoded: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, specifically the tent and all its furnishings: its clasps, its wooden frames, its crossbars, its posts, and its bases.

verses.kjv: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.decoded: And the covering made of ram skins dyed red, and the covering made of badger skins, and the veil that served as a covering,

verses.kjv: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.decoded: The Ark of the Covenant, along with its carrying poles, and the atonement cover.

verses.kjv: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.decoded: The table, along with all its utensils, and the bread of presence,

verses.kjv: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.decoded: The pure lampstand, along with its lamps, specifically the lamps that were to be arranged, and all its utensils, and the oil for illumination,

verses.kjv: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
verses.decoded: This includes the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.decoded: The bronze altar, along with its bronze grating, its poles, all its utensils, the basin, and its stand.

verses.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.decoded: The curtains of the courtyard, its posts, and its bases, and the curtain for the courtyard entrance, its ropes, and its pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting.

verses.kjv: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: The special clothing for performing duties in the holy place, and the sacred garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons, were all for serving in the priestly role.

verses.kjv: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
verses.decoded: In accordance with everything the Lord instructed Moses, the Israelites completed all the work.

verses.kjv: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.decoded: And Moses inspected all the work, and observed that they had completed it exactly as the Lord had commanded; indeed, they had done it precisely in that way. Then Moses blessed them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.decoded: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.kjv: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.decoded: On the first day of the first month, you are to set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
verses.decoded: And you shall place inside it the ark of the covenant, and cover the ark with the curtain.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.decoded: And you shall bring in the table, and arrange on it the items that are to be arranged there; and you shall bring in the lampstand, and light its lamps.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And you shall set up the golden altar for incense in front of the ark of the covenant, and hang the curtain for the entrance of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the altar for burnt offerings in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, which is the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.decoded: And you shall place the washing basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
verses.decoded: And you shall set up the courtyard all around, and hang the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.decoded: And you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and everything that is in it; and you shall consecrate it and all its utensils, so that it may become holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
verses.decoded: And you must anoint the altar for burnt offerings, and all its associated equipment, and make the altar holy; and it will be an extremely sacred altar.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
verses.decoded: And you shall anoint the basin and its base, and make it holy.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
verses.decoded: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and wash them with water.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: And you shall dress Aaron in the sacred clothing, and consecrate him with oil, and set him apart for sacred service; so that he may serve me as a priest.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
verses.decoded: And you shall bring his sons, and dress them in tunics:

verses.kjv: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.decoded: And you shall anoint them, just as you anointed their father, so that they may serve me as priests: for their anointing will certainly establish an everlasting priesthood for all their descendants.

verses.kjv: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.decoded: Moses carried out all actions exactly as the Lord had commanded him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.decoded: It happened in the first month of the second year, on the first day of that month, that the tabernacle was set up.

verses.kjv: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
verses.decoded: And Moses erected the tabernacle, and secured its bases, and set up its frames, and inserted its crossbars, and raised its support pillars.

verses.kjv: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle, and placed the tent's covering on top of it, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
verses.decoded: And he took the tablets of the covenant and placed them inside the ark. Then he inserted the carrying poles into the rings on the ark, and he put the atonement cover on top of the ark.

verses.kjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and he put up the curtain that served as a covering, and he covered the ark containing the tablets of the covenant, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
verses.decoded: And he placed the table inside the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the Tabernacle, outside of the curtain.

verses.kjv: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he arranged the bread on the table in the presence of the Lord, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.decoded: Then he placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he lit the lamps in the presence of the Lord, just as the Lord had instructed Moses.

verses.kjv: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
verses.decoded: And he placed the gold altar inside the Tent of Meeting, in front of the curtain.

verses.kjv: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And he erected the curtain at the entrance of the sacred tent.

verses.kjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And he placed the altar for burnt offerings near the entrance of the tabernacle, which was the tent of meeting, and on it he presented the burnt offering and the grain offering.

verses.kjv: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
verses.decoded: And he placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and filled it with water for washing.

verses.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.decoded: And Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet at that place.

verses.kjv: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: When they entered the Tent of Meeting, and when they approached the altar, they performed ritual washing, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.decoded: And he erected the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he put up the curtain for the entrance of the courtyard. So Moses completed the work.

verses.kjv: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: Subsequently, a cloud enveloped the meeting tent, and the majestic presence of God filled the sacred dwelling.

verses.kjv: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And Moses could not enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud remained on it, and the glorious presence of the Lord filled the Tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
verses.decoded: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out on their journeys.

verses.kjv: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.decoded: However, if the cloud did not ascend, then they would not travel until the day it did ascend.

verses.kjv: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.decoded: Because the cloud of the Lord rested upon the tabernacle during the day, and fire was visible within it at night, all the people of Israel could see it throughout their travels.
